alertRules.name: alert-evac-plan-sla-warning
alertRules.description: Plan-generation p95 exceeded 30 seconds over five minutes.
alertRules.query: customMetrics | where name == "evacuation.plan_generation_latency" | summarize AggregatedValue = percentile(todouble(value), 95)

alertRules.name: alert-evac-plan-sla-critical
alertRules.displayName: Evacuation plan generation sustained SLA breach
alertRules.description: Plan-generation p95 exceeded 30 seconds over fifteen minutes.
alertRules.query: customMetrics | where name == "evacuation.plan_generation_latency" | summarize AggregatedValue = percentile(todouble(value), 95)

alertRules.name: alert-evac-replan-sla
alertRules.description: Replan p95 exceeded 15 seconds over five minutes.
alertRules.query: customMetrics | where name == "evacuation.replan_latency" | summarize AggregatedValue = percentile(todouble(value), 95)

alertRules.name: alert-evac-road-data-stale
alertRules.description: The road-network source remained stale for fifteen minutes.
alertRules.query: customMetrics | where name == "evacuation.road_data_stale" | summarize AggregatedValue = min(todouble(value))

alertRules.name: alert-evac-llm-unavailable
alertRules.description: More than five deterministic fallback activations occurred in five minutes.
alertRules.query: customMetrics | where name == "evacuation.fallback_mode_activations" | summarize AggregatedValue = sum(todouble(value))

alertRules.name: alert-evac-audit-degradation
alertRules.description: The audit writer used memory/WAL or file-spill storage during the five-minute window.
alertRules.query: customMetrics | where name == "evacuation.audit_tier" | summarize AggregatedValue = max(todouble(value))

alertRules.name: alert-evac-audit-buffer-capacity
alertRules.description: The in-memory audit buffer exceeded 8000 records.
alertRules.query: customMetrics | where name == "evacuation.audit_buffer_depth" | summarize AggregatedValue = max(todouble(value))

alertRules.name: alert-evac-shelter-rate
alertRules.description: More than five shelter-in-place recommendations occurred in thirty minutes.
alertRules.query: customMetrics | where name == "evacuation.shelter_in_place_count" | summarize AggregatedValue = sum(todouble(value))

alertRules.name: alert-evac-emergency-escalation
alertRules.description: At least one immediate-threat emergency escalation occurred.
alertRules.query: customMetrics | where name == "evacuation.emergency_escalation_count" | summarize AggregatedValue = sum(todouble(value))

alertRules.name: alert-evac-no-plans
alertRules.description: Handoffs were received but the latest active-plan count remained zero for ten minutes.
alertRules.query: let Handoffs = toscalar(customMetrics | where name == "evacuation.handoff_intake_count" | summarize sum(todouble(value))); let ActivePlans = toscalar(customMetrics | where name == "evacuation.active_plans_gauge" | summarize arg_max(timestamp, value) | project todouble(value)); print AggregatedValue = iff(coalesce(Handoffs, 0.0) > 0 and coalesce(ActivePlans, 0.0) == 0, 1.0, 0.0)

alertRules.name: alert-evac-congestion-risk
alertRules.description: More than half of generated routes were congestion-risk routes in five minutes.
alertRules.query: customMetrics | where name in ("evacuation.congestion_risk_routes", "evacuation.routes_per_plan") | summarize RiskRoutes = sumif(todouble(value), name == "evacuation.congestion_risk_routes"), TotalRoutes = sumif(todouble(value), name == "evacuation.routes_per_plan") | extend AggregatedValue = iff(TotalRoutes > 0, 100.0 * RiskRoutes / TotalRoutes, 0.0) | project AggregatedValue

alertRules.name: alert-evac-capacity-limit
alertRules.description: The active-plan count exceeded 40 and approached the 50-plan capacity limit.
alertRules.query: customMetrics | where name == "evacuation.active_plans_gauge" | summarize AggregatedValue = max(todouble(value))
